import novamind_api as nm

print("=== current_day:", nm.vars.current_day, "===")

# 1) Leads by group, this week
r = nm.query("SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) n FROM customers WHERE created_day BETWEEN 197 AND 203 GROUP BY group_id")
print("\n1) Leads by group d197-203:", r['rows'])

# 2) S1 leads by day
r = nm.query("SELECT created_day, COUNT(*) n FROM customers WHERE group_id='S1' AND created_day BETWEEN 197 AND 203 GROUP BY created_day ORDER BY created_day")
print("\n2) S1 leads by day:", r['rows'])

# 3) S1 fresh subs by day/plan/status (conv check)
r = nm.query("""SELECT s.start_day, s.plan, s.status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE c.group_id='S1' AND s.start_day BETWEEN 197 AND 203
GROUP BY s.start_day, s.plan, s.status ORDER BY s.start_day, s.plan""")
print("\n3) S1 fresh subs by day/plan/status:")
for row in r['rows']: print("  ", row)

# 4) S1 conv summary: subs (not lost) vs lost
r = nm.query("""SELECT s.status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s
